name: saiyan-fight
description: Saiyan Fight. O jogo é HTML/CSS/JS puro (sem build); este package.json só serve para empacotar o APK Android com o Capacitor.

scripts.android: node scripts/android/copiar-web.js && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: for f in *.js tests/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --test tests/game-logic-core.test.js && for t in tests/*.test.js; do [ "$t" = tests/game-logic-core.test.js ] || node "$t" || exit 1; done
